name: Hamza
bio: I'm a full-stack developer and AI enthusiast based in Faisalabad, Pakistan. I love building products that combine great UX with intelligent backends. Currently obsessed with LangGraph and agentic AI systems.

projects.title: AgentFolio
projects.description: An AI-powered portfolio platform where a LangGraph agent answers questions about you in first person, using your CV and LinkedIn data as RAG context.

projects.title: Smart Expense Tracker
projects.description: A mobile-friendly expense tracker with NLP-based categorisation. Users can describe an expense in plain English and the app auto-categorises it.

experience.description: Built and shipped 10+ web applications for clients across Pakistan and the Middle East. Specialised in React/Next.js frontends and FastAPI/Django backends.

education.institution: University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore
